headline: Lesotho Launches US$33.5 Million Road Rebuild Project
summary: Lesotho launched a US$33.5 million rebuild of the 64-kilometre road from its airport to Mafeteng, backed by a Chinese contractor.
why: Infrastructure investments in developing nations impact local economic development, construction sectors, and bilateral trade relationships.

impacts.name: Lesotho
impacts.why: Capital expenditure on roads enhances local transport networks.
